data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of prior year provisions 1,824
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves amounting to $1.824 million in 2024, representing 41.09% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening is explicitly stated as a 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' in the technical provisions note. The report discusses general factors influencing reserve estimates, including actuarial and statistical projections, judgement regarding past claims development, claim inflation, public attitude to claiming, economic conditions, portfolio mix, policy conditions, claims handling procedures, interest rates, settlement delays, and foreign currency rates, but does not attribute the specific movement to any particular event or line of business.

However, ultimate liability will vary as a result of subsequent information and events and this may result in significant adjustments to the amounts provided.
